name: Mirage 2000 - Atlas Cheetah C
summary: SAAF Atlas Cheetah C liveries for the M-2000C, with variants for the three SAAF roundels.
description: South African Air Force Cheetah C style liveries for the DCS M-2000C. The 26/03/24 update fixed roundel orientation and added liveries with the three SAAF roundels. The page gives no install path; liveries normally go in `Saved Games\DCS\Liveries\M-2000C`.

releases.changelog: Corrected roundel orientation; added three liveries with the existing SAAF roundels.
